analyst_view.overall: Bodø/Glimt are 25th of 36 with 4 points, both earned at home (1-0 against Dortmund, 0-0 against Lille), so this game on the Aspmyra artificial pitch is close to a must-win for the play-off places; LASK are 16th with 6 points and arrive on five straight league wins, the last a 2-1 over Hartberg on Saturday. For Bodø, Håkon Evjen (knee ligaments) and August Mikkelsen (groin) are out and already counted, and UEFA lists no doubts, so Isak Sjong is no longer flagged. For LASK, vice-captain and centre-back Andrés Andrade is out with ankle ligament damage confirmed by MRI (ORF, Laola1), which the numbers do not know; George Bello is out and counted, and UEFA's team news also lists Florian Flecker (calf), one of LASK's three joint top scorers in this competition with 3 goals, which I found only there. Miguel Freckleton is available again after missing Saturday through tiredness from international duty. Turkish referee Halil Umut Meler is in charge and his higher card rate is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals (2.7 Bodø, 1.1 LASK), already counting LASK's hot scoring run (+2.8%) and Evjen, Mikkelsen and Bello. What changed since this morning: UEFA now lists Flecker out, which takes one of LASK's main Champions League scorers away and outweighs the boost Bodø get from Andrade's absence; also Bodø's two home games in this competition produced one goal in total. I move from +5% to -4%, about 3.7 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners, 5.9 of them for Bodø as the side expected to have the ball, with both teams' recent corner counts (+0.8% and -1.0%) already in. LASK's wing-backs Jørgensen and Dibango are set to play their usual roles and Bodø attack down the flanks with Blomberg and Hauge, which is what the numbers expect, so I stay at 10.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, already adding referee Halil Umut Meler's 4.5 cards a game (+7.5%) and taking off LASK's low recent card count (-6.6%) and Bodø's (-2.1%). There is no rivalry here; a LASK back three with the 18-year-old Verhaeghe in place of Andrade might foul a bit more, but that is a normal away-team picture, so I stay at 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 27 shots (14.5 Bodø, 12.5 LASK), already trimmed for Bodø's quieter recent shooting (-3.9%). Bodø need the win and will push, while LASK without Flecker still bring Usor and Kalajdzic forward; these pull both ways, so I stay at 27.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target, already counting LASK's sharp recent finishing (+3.9%) and Bodø's slight dip (-2.0%). The new absences on the LASK side (Andrade at the back, Flecker up front) roughly cancel for shots on target, and I have put the net effect into goals rather than counting it twice, so I stay at 10.5.
